exposure: self-recollection of pregnancy and birth details
outcome: concordance between self-recalled and prospective birth details
cohort: 708 women who had participated in the OPPTIMUM trial (a randomised trial of progesterone pessaries to prevent PTB)
finding: Self-collected DNA samples from mothers and babies were sufficient for genetic analysis, but yields were variable, and self-recollection of pregnancy and birth details was inadequate for accurately phenotyping PTB.
mod_finding: While the study investigated various factors related to preterm birth, it did not find a significant association between mode of delivery and preterm birth.
